description: This Java source file defines the HomeListenerService class, which extends WearableListenerService. It listens for DataItem events on an Android wearable device to detect geofence-related data changes and deletions, and posts or cancels notifications accordingly.

classes.name: HomeListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for DataItem changes on a wearable device, handling geofence data and managing notifications based on geofence events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes and connects the GoogleApiClient when the service is created.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in DataItems, posting notifications when geofence data changes and canceling notifications when data is deleted.

methods.name: cancelNotificationForDataItem
methods.description: Cancels the notification related to a specific DataItem when it is deleted.

methods.name: postNotificationForGeofenceId
methods.description: Posts a notification informing the user they've entered a geofence, with options to check-in or delete the data item.
